On the way to work

Freezing sleet cuts into your face while waiting twenty minutes for the delayed Route 14 bus. A passing delivery van splashes dirty curb water across your ankles.

Your damp socks stay cold all morning. Your teeth chatter as you board.

Your shift

Slice tape, fold flaps, slap shipping label, slide tote. You repeat the exact sequence 180 times in two hours. Your heels burn against the sealed concrete. In your pocket, your phone buzzes twice.

The warehouse team smashes the quarterly dispatch record by 4:30 PM. The shift lead calls an early pack-up with full shift wages guaranteed. A palpable buzz of accomplishment fills the locker room as everyone packs their bags.
